sentences.en: There wasn't a single seat available on the overcrowded bus.
sentences.zh: 1. 在那辆过度拥挤的公共汽车上连一个空座位都没有。

sentences.en: The bus was overcrowded. I should have got a taxi.
sentences.zh: 2. 这辆公共汽车太挤了。我真该打车来的。

sentences.en: I thought I would suffocate on the overcrowded train.
sentences.zh: 3. 我觉得在那辆人满为患的火车上我会窒息而死。

phrases.zh: 监狱过度拥挤：监狱里人太多。

senses.zh: 挤满的,过度拥挤的v.拥挤(overcrowd的过去式和过去分词)
